visual_brief.subject: AWS Emulator gives tests and coding agents a local AWS-shaped API target
verified_context: AWS says the free open-source emulator runs a local HTTPS endpoint compatible with AWS-shaped APIs, letting existing CLI, SDK and test calls target a laptop instead of a live Region.
A coding agent can create and inspect cloud-shaped resources locally, but the safety benefit depends on real credential, endpoint and network boundaries.
Local behavior cannot guarantee production fidelity for identity, timing, quotas, distributed failure or service interactions.
visual_brief.editorial_idea: A compact cloud rehearsal chamber sits inside a bounded workbench, where a terracotta test signal loops locally while the route to the distant real cloud stays physically closed.
visual_brief.visual_metaphor: A small dark cloud-shaped stone chamber inside a portable case contains a closed terracotta loop; a separate outer gate blocks the path toward a distant larger cloud.

candidate_notes.A: Rejected after comparison. The local case and distant cloud are clear, but repeated arrowheads push the composition toward a bare technical diagram.
candidate_notes.B: Rejected at the constitutional gate because it introduced a literal laptop and workstation scene despite the brief's abstract-boundary requirement.
candidate_notes.C: Selected. The local resource loop sits inside a nested cloud-shaped boundary, and a closed physical valve separates it from the remote cloud without implying production fidelity.

crop_review.article_desktop: The nested local cloud, resource loop, closed valve and separate remote cloud remain visible across the 1600×900 hero.
crop_review.article_mobile: A centered cover crop retains the local boundary, complete loop and valve; the remote cloud remains sufficient context at the edge.
crop_review.thumbnail: The dark nested chamber, terracotta loop and closed valve remain distinct at 320px.

golden_reference_comparison: The selected candidate matches the developer-tooling references through compact physical containment, warm paper, restrained charcoal and stone forms, sparse terracotta signaling and a strong center-safe silhouette.
